messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Hosted runtime (us-east-1) kv-cache OOM spike — error rate 45% on /v1/generate, memory pressure > 95% on kvcache nodes. Incident ID: INC-2063. Link: https://infra.redwood/alerts/2063

alex (sre): acked. I'm pausing new low-priority traffic routes and pulling recent heapdump. Assigning runtime & eng.

maria (runtime): looking. Early signs: continuous-batching + aggressive prefetching produced many tiny prefetched KV entries for long-tail contexts — eviction not keeping up. Seeing lots of wraparound entries.

kai (eng): any recent deploys? I can revert a quick change if needed.

alex (sre): last deploy 2062999800 touched batching heuristics (PR #3847). I'll check diffs.

maria (runtime): logs snippet: ```
[2026-03-14T16:12:03Z] kvcache: alloc=98.7% total=119GB limit=120GB entries=12.6M prefix_len=512 prefetch_hits=0
[2026-03-14T16:12:04Z] eviction: backlog=3200ms windows=46 reclaim=failed
OOM: kvcache exhausted memory
```

kai (eng): yep PR #3847 changed `continuous_batching.target_batch_duration` and `prefetch.window` growth. Hypothesis: longer target duration caused more batching of short requests, prefetch turned on for those leading to huge number of cached keys per request.

julia (support): customer impact — two mid-market customers reported 5xxs starting ~16:10 UTC, about 0.8% of total calls. I'll notify accounts.

maria (runtime): short mitigation: throttle prefetch and reduce batch window for hosted tier. Proposed immediate flags: `kvcache.prefetch.enabled=false` (for hosted-default) and `continuous_batching.max_batch_size=8` (reduce from 64).

alex (sre): will push flags now. Executing hotpatch:
```bash
# disable prefetch for hosted default route
curl -XPOST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://console.redwood/api/flags 
  -d '{"scope":"hosted-default","kvcache.prefetch.enabled":false}'
# reduce batch size globally for runtime pool us-east-1
curl -XPOST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://console.redwood/api/runtime/config 
  -d '{"pool":"us-east-1","continuous_batching.max_batch_size":8}'
```

alex (sre): hotpatch applied. Rolling over nodes — taking ~30s. Monitoring.

ops-bot: Deploy started: hotpatch/2063000000 by alex. CI checks skipped (emergency).

maria (runtime): watching metrics — kvcache entries dropping, reclaim latency down. eviction backlog down from 3200ms -> 120ms. Memory at 67% now.

kai (eng): Suggest immediate revert of PR #3847 to be safe. Can we roll back commit 1a2b3c?

alex (sre): initiating revert to previous runtime config now. `git revert 1a2b3c && ./deploy/runtime-deploy --target=us-east-1 --patch`

alex (sre): revert applied, deployment in progress.

maria (runtime): metrics stabilized. Error rate on /v1/generate down from 45% -> 1.2% within 3 minutes. No new OOMs.

julia (support): notified affected customers and account teams: AcmeCo, BrightHealth, MiroLabs. All acknowledged. Support ticket updates being sent.

kai (eng): will open follow-up PR to add stricter guardrails: cap on prefetch per-request, and eviction-driven backpressure for batching. Also add a non-blocking circuit to disable prefetch automatically when kvcache memory > 80%.

alex (sre): preparing handoff. Next oncall: @maria is primary for follow-up today. Summary for next shift: root cause likely regression in batching heuristics that increased prefetch population for short requests causing eviction starvation -> OOM. Mitigations applied: disabled prefetch for hosted-default, reduced max_batch_size to 8, reverted PR #3847. Customer impact: transient 5xxs for ~0.8% of calls, three customers reported issues, now resolved.

maria (runtime): adding postmortem checklist: capture heapdumps, correlate request shapes that triggered large prefetches, add unit tests for prefetch rate-limits, and add runtime alert rule to trigger at 80% kvcache usage.

ops-bot: Postmortem ticket created INC-2063-PM -> https://pm.redwood/incidents/2063. Assigned: kai (eng), maria (runtime), alex (sre).

julia (support): leaving notes in customer tickets. Will follow up with status updates tomorrow. :thumbsup:

alex (sre): leaving channel — oncall handoff complete. If anything spikes, @maria please escalate to oncall pager.

maria (runtime): ack. Will run a controlled canary of the follow-up PR after hours and check long-tail token distributions.

ops-bot: Handoff complete. Next_check_in: 2063003600 (1h).
